references.section: Prohibited Use of Images for AI Training, clause 25
references.finding: Current standard website terms prohibit AI training, validation and testing of website images; separately licensed AI data are offered. No LUMYVUE-specific grant was found.
references.image_origin_caveat: Filename hints do not establish an individual image's origin or historical licence. No automatic restricted-rights adjudication was made.

references.finding: Hosting does not establish upstream image rights; no image-linked LUMYVUE training grant was established from this policy.
Archived CC BY 4.0 statements are retained as licence declarations, not discarded or treated as blanket proof of upstream ownership and consent.
